subject.title: fix(shared): skip app-group identity migration when OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR is overridden

question: Should explicit `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` stores remain isolated from App Group identity/auth migration even if an override-based relocated install may need to re-pair?
rationale: The code fix is coherent, but the behavior deliberately changes auth/session migration under an existing environment override and should be accepted as maintainer policy before merge.

options.title: Land isolated override semantics
options.body: Treat an explicit state-dir override as a caller-chosen independent store and merge after exact-head validation.

options.title: Require relocated-install proof
options.body: Ask for a real macOS override/relocated-state run showing the expected re-pair or preserved behavior before merge.

options.title: Add opt-in migration path
options.body: If override stores should import App Group state, add an explicit migration or doctor path instead of implicit runtime import.

recommendation.title: Land isolated override semantics
recommendation.body: Treat an explicit state-dir override as a caller-chosen independent store and merge after exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current follow-up and the prior auth-store migration fixup on the same storage boundary.
